proposed_facts.reason: Independently read the selector, wrappers, switch helper, and OSContext assembly. The source signature and yield interpretation are preserved. OSSaveContext saves GPR 3 as 1 while immediately returning 0; OSLoadContext ends in rfi, supporting the correction to ordinary post-dispatch return semantics.

The selector independently confirms both guards, state-2-only requeueing, context-state mask-2 save bypass, restored nonzero save return, idle waiting, priority selection, conditional bitmap clearing, and selected-thread state updates. The document agrees and does not turn yielding into a guarantee of switching to a different thread.

OSExitThread independently confirms detached removal/state 0, joinable retention/state 8 and result storage, mutex-release and wakeup calls, and a selection request. SelectThread can reject that request under suppression or context mismatch. The correction appropriately avoids an unconditional handoff claim.

contradictions.reason: Accept the five .bss fact deferrals and the .bss scheduling-link deferral. Declarations, bootstrap initialization, and optional idle-thread lifecycle establish source-level behavior, not compiled section membership. The overlapping .bss/.sbss scalar inventories cannot be resolved from the .bss comment. Supported object behavior and inherited retained knowledge remain retained.
Accept all four .sbss fact deferrals. Count, bitmap, and hint producers and consumers are supported, but those operations do not establish .sbss ownership, a 16-byte extent, or padding.

Accept all four .data fact deferrals and the .data diagnostic-link deferral. Diagnostic consumers and source literals are evident; compiled placement and the surviving preprocessed literal inventory are not. No section-specific replacement is justified.

Accept all four .sdata fact deferrals and the .sdata diagnostic-link deferral. ASSERTREPORT failures and the unknown-state branch both supply empty panic text, contradicting unknown-state-only usage. Source calls cannot establish .sdata ownership, pooling, an eight-byte contribution, or alignment; the document explicitly preserves that distinction.

Accept superseding the selector return and state-behavior claims. The dispatch helper loads the selected context through rfi, and the selector conditionally requeues and saves rather than doing either unconditionally. Existing function names remain appropriate; unchanged rendered names are not treated as independent proof.

Accept superseding the unconditional exit-handoff claim. Cleanup and scheduling requests are supported, but selector guards remain operative. This acceptance covers the proposed corrections and examined contradictions, not a new audit of every inherited retained row.
